gbm_population_evidence.quote: Nk Cell Therapy for Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiform Patients

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] NK cell therapy: Activated NK cell injection in tumor cavity of patient with GBM (Glioblastoma Multiform)

role_evidence.quote: The investigators will inject the activated NK cells, 1-3 times with weekly interval into tumor cavity.

agents.drug_class_hint: ex vivo activated haploidentical natural killer cell therapy, intracavitary injection

coder_notes: Cell therapy only (excluded intervention type). Ages CHILD and ADULT (3-60 years), mixed_age. 'Glioblastoma Multiform' -> historical terminology. formulation_flag new_route reflects intratumoral-cavity injection.
